name: Cajun Sausage and Vegetables Skillet
fit_evidence: 440 cal (in 400-650), 9 g carb (<=35), budget one-pan skillet, no seafood, scales to 14 by weigh-and-divide.
dedup_evidence: No catalog collision: the nearest sausage-skillet catalog recipes (cheesy-smoked-sausage-rice-skillet, turkey-sausage-and-peppers-rice-skillet, polish-leczo-kielbasa-peppers-stew) are all rice/tomato-starch based, whereas this is a starch-free Cajun andouille + zucchini/squash/pepper/onion skillet; no starch-free Cajun sausage-and-vegetables dish exists in the 544-recipe digest.
cuisine: Cajun / Creole (American South) - widens the American/Tex-Mex-skewed catalog.
cross_protein_collision_flags: Same-dish-different-protein risk with a smoked-turkey-sausage version in the turkey lane (a 'Cajun turkey sausage and vegetables skillet') - board carries smoked-turkey-sausage, and rebuilding this on that item would make it structurally identical; decider should check the turkey pool.
Also collides in spirit with a chicken-sausage Cajun veggie skillet if one surfaces.

Within this pork-sausage lane, note italian-sausage-peppers-onions-skillet (already accepted) is a sibling starch-free sausage skillet but a DIFFERENT dish - Italian flavor + italian sausage vs Cajun flavor + andouille, distinct dinner (paprikash-vs-goulash rule); not a dupe, flagged for decider awareness.
notes: Andouille is unmapped (board has kielbasa, italian-sausage, smoked-turkey-sausage, bratwurst); per v2.1 5.1 the unmapped pick is wanted for the pricer lane, not penalized.
